scenario: A household submits SNAP recertification paperwork (earned-income pay stubs, shelter/utility expense receipts, and a household composition form). The agent pipeline parses all submitted documents to extract income and expense figures, computes household net income by applying the standard deduction, earned-income deduction (20%), dependent-care deduction, and excess shelter deduction, then compares the result against the 130% FPL gross-income test and net-income test to produce a signed recertification determination memo.
info_flow: habib-pdf-to-json extracts income and expense figures from the submitted PDFs into a structured data table → financial-calculator applies SNAP deductions and computes adjusted net income against the FPL thresholds → reporting generates the recertification determination memo.
